import Mathlib

inductive Color
| Red
| Black
deriving Inhabited, BEq

inductive Node
| Empty : Node
| Tree  (color : Color) (val : Int) (left : Node) (right : Node) : Node
deriving Inhabited

def view (t : Node) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => ∅
  | Node.Tree _ v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_red (t : Node) : Bool :=
  match t with
  | Node.Tree Color.Red _ _ _ => true
  | _ => false

def get_color (t : Node) : Color :=
  match t with
  | Node.Tree c _ _ _ => c
  | Node.Empty => Color.Black -- Empty nodes are black

def is_bst (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree _ v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

-- Black Height: Returns -1 if invalid
def black_height (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => 1
  | Node.Tree c _ l r =>
    let lh := black_height l
    let rh := black_height r
    if lh ≠ -1 ∧ rh ≠ -1 ∧ lh = rh then
      if c == Color.Black then lh + 1 else lh
    else
      -1

def satisfies_red_props (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree _ _ l r =>
    satisfies_red_props l ∧
    satisfies_red_props r ∧
    -- Rule: No Right-Leaning Red
    (¬ is_red r) ∧
    -- Rule: No Double Red on Left
    (match l with
     | Node.Tree Color.Red _ ll _ => ¬ is_red ll
     | _ => True)

-- Main Invariant
def is_llrbt (t : Node) : Prop :=
  is_bst t ∧
  black_height t ≠ -1 ∧
  satisfies_red_props t

def get_left (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.Tree _ _ l _ => some l | _ => none

def get_right (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.Tree _ _ _ r => some r | _ => none

def get_val (t : Node) : Option Int :=
  match t with | Node.Tree _ v _ _ => some v | _ => none

def is_not_empty (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with | Node.Empty => False | _ => True

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def flip_colors_precond (t : Node) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  -- t is not empty
  is_not_empty t ∧
  is_bst t ∧
  match t with
  | Node.Tree c _ l r =>
    is_not_empty l ∧ is_not_empty r ∧
    (get_color l = get_color r) ∧
    (c ≠ get_color l)
  | _ => False
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def flip_color (c : Color) : Color :=
  match c with
  | Color.Red => Color.Black
  | Color.Black => Color.Red

def flip_node (t : Node) : Node :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree c v l r => Node.Tree (flip_color c) v l r

def flip_colors_impl (t : Node) : Node :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree c v l r => Node.Tree (flip_color c) v (flip_node l) (flip_node r)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def flip_colors (t : Node) 
    (h_precond : flip_colors_precond t) : Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  flip_colors_impl t
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def flip_colors_postcond (t : Node) (result : Node)
    (_ : flip_colors_precond t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  view result = view t ∧
  is_bst result ∧ -- Requirement 1: BST structure preserved
  black_height result = black_height t ∧ -- Requirement 2: Balance preserved (Critical)
  match result, t with
  | Node.Tree c' _ l' r', Node.Tree c _ l r =>
      c' ≠ c ∧
      get_color l' ≠ get_color l ∧
      get_color r' ≠ get_color r
  | _, _ => False
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma bh_tree_black (v : Int) (l r : Node) :
    black_height (Node.Tree Color.Black v l r) =
      if black_height l ≠ -1 ∧ black_height r ≠ -1 ∧ black_height l = black_height r then
        black_height l + 1
      else -1 := by
  first
    | rfl
    | simp only [black_height]
    | simp [black_height]

lemma bh_tree_red (v : Int) (l r : Node) :
    black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red v l r) =
      if black_height l ≠ -1 ∧ black_height r ≠ -1 ∧ black_height l = black_height r then
        black_height l
      else -1 := by
  first
    | rfl
    | simp only [black_height]
    | simp [black_height]

lemma bh_valid (t : Node) : black_height t = -1 ∨ 1 ≤ black_height t := by
  induction t with
  | Empty => right; simp [black_height]
  | Tree c v l r ihl ihr =>
    cases c with
    | Red =>
      rw [bh_tree_red]
      split_ifs with h
      · rcases ihl with h1 | h1
        · exact absurd h1 h.1
        · exact Or.inr h1
      · exact Or.inl rfl
    | Black =>
      rw [bh_tree_black]
      split_ifs with h
      · rcases ihl with h1 | h1
        · exact absurd h1 h.1
        · right; omega
      · exact Or.inl rfl
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem flip_colors_postcond_satisfied (t : Node)
    (h_precond : flip_colors_precond t) :
    flip_colors_postcond t (flip_colors t h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  cases t with
  | Empty =>
    first
      | exact (h_precond.2.2 : False).elim
      | simp at h_precond
  | Tree c v l r =>
    cases l with
    | Empty =>
      first
        | exact (h_precond.2.2.1 : False).elim
        | simp [is_not_empty] at h_precond
    | Tree cl vl ll lr =>
      cases r with
      | Empty =>
        first
          | exact (h_precond.2.2.2.1 : False).elim
          | simp [is_not_empty] at h_precond
      | Tree cr vr rl rr =>
        have hbst : is_bst (Node.Tree c v (Node.Tree cl vl ll lr) (Node.Tree cr vr rl rr)) :=
          h_precond.2.1
        have hcol : cl = cr := h_precond.2.2.2.2.1
        have hcne : c ≠ cl := h_precond.2.2.2.2.2
        have hA := bh_valid ll
        have hB := bh_valid lr
        have hC := bh_valid rl
        have hD := bh_valid rr
        cases c with
        | Red =>
          cases cl with
          | Red => exact absurd rfl hcne
          | Black =>
            cases cr with
            | Red => exact absurd hcol (by simp)
            | Black =>
              simp only [flip_colors, flip_colors_impl, flip_node, flip_color]
              refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
              · first | rfl | simp [view]
              · first
                  | exact hbst
                  | (simp only [is_bst, view] at hbst ⊢; exact hbst)
              · first
                  | (simp only [bh_tree_red, bh_tree_black]; split_ifs <;> omega)
                  | (simp only [bh_tree_red, bh_tree_black]
                     split_ifs <;> (push_neg at * ; omega))
              · simp
              · simp [get_color]
              · simp [get_color]
        | Black =>
          cases cl with
          | Red =>
            cases cr with
            | Red =>
              simp only [flip_colors, flip_colors_impl, flip_node, flip_color]
              refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
              · first | rfl | simp [view]
              · first
                  | exact hbst
                  | (simp only [is_bst, view] at hbst ⊢; exact hbst)
              · first
                  | (simp only [bh_tree_red, bh_tree_black]; split_ifs <;> omega)
                  | (simp only [bh_tree_red, bh_tree_black]
                     split_ifs <;> (push_neg at * ; omega))
              · simp
              · simp [get_color]
              · simp [get_color]
            | Black => exact absurd hcol (by simp)
          | Black => exact absurd rfl hcne
  -- !benchmark @end proof

## Analysis

**Algorithm.** `flip_colors` on a node `Tree c v l r` (with `l`, `r` non‑empty, `color l = color r ≠ c`) simply inverts the colour of the node and of both children. Values and shapes are untouched.

**Why the postconditions hold.**

* `view` and `is_bst` do not look at colours at all, so after flipping only colours the resulting propositions/sets are *definitionally* the same.
* Black height: let `A = bh ll`, `B = bh lr`, `C = bh rl`, `D = bh rr`.
  For a node, `bh (Tree c _ l r) = -1` unless both children are valid with equal heights, in which case it is `bh l (+1 if black)`. Hence flipping a non‑empty node changes its black height by exactly `+1` (Red→Black) or `-1` (Black→Red), and *validity* itself does not depend on the node's own colour. So:
  * `c=Black`, children `Red`: originally `bh t = A+1` (when valid); after flip the children become Black (`A+1` each) and the node Red, giving `A+1` again.
  * `c=Red`, children `Black`: originally `bh t = A+1`; after flip children are Red (`A`) and node Black, giving `A+1`.
  * If any subtree is invalid, both sides are `-1`.
  To make the arithmetic go through we need that a black height is either `-1` or `≥ 1` (lemma `bh_valid`).
* Colour inversion is immediate by constructor disequality.

**Proof plan.** Helper `flip_color`/`flip_node`/`flip_colors_impl` (so the proof argument can be discarded), unfolding lemmas `bh_tree_black`, `bh_tree_red`, the range lemma `bh_valid`, then a full case analysis on the two admissible colour configurations, closing the black‑height goal by `split_ifs <;> omega`.

  | Node.Empty => Color.Black -- Empty nodes are black

def is_bst (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree _ v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

-- Black Height: Returns -1 if invalid
def black_height (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => 1
  | Node.Tree c _ l r =>
    let lh := black_height l
    let rh := black_height r
    if lh ≠ -1 ∧ rh ≠ -1 ∧ lh = rh then
      if c == Color.Black then lh + 1 else lh
    else
      -1

def satisfies_red_props (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree _ _ l r =>
    satisfies_red_props l ∧
    satisfies_red_props r ∧
    -- Rule: No Right-Leaning Red
    (¬ is_red r) ∧
    -- Rule: No Double Red on Left
    (match l with
     | Node.Tree Color.Red _ ll _ => ¬ is_red ll
     | _ => True)

-- Main Invariant
def is_llrbt (t : Node) : Prop :=
  is_bst t ∧
  black_height t ≠ -1 ∧
  satisfies_red_props t

def get_left (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.Tree _ _ l _ => some l | _ => none

def get_right (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.Tree _ _ _ r => some r | _ => none

def get_val (t : Node) : Option Int :=

def flip_color (c : Color) : Color :=

  | Color.Black => Color.Red

def flip_node (t : Node) : Node :=

  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree c v l r => Node.Tree (flip_color c) v l r

def flip_colors_impl (t : Node) : Node :=
